exercises.name: Seated Hip Rotations
cues: Sit with knees bent, feet on the floor, hands behind the hips.
Drop both knees to one side (front hip external, back hip internal rotation), then through the start to the other side.
Let torso and hips move at first; over time keep the torso facing forward. Breathe through the nose.

exercises.name: Wall Downward Dog Spine Opener
cues: Hands on a wall, table or counter at hip to chest height; hinge forward.
Push the chest down to open the mid and upper back, arms moving toward the ears, then back to start.
Breathe out as the chest goes down, in as you come back.

exercises.name: Wall Hip Flexor & Quad Stretch (Couch Stretch)
cues: Shin vertical against the wall, soft pad under the knee, other leg in a lunge.
Squeeze the glute, brace the core, tuck the pelvis (posterior tilt); avoid arching the lower back.
V1: one hand down, torso diagonal (hip flexors). V2: torso upright (quads). Easier: kneeling hip flexor stretch or couch version.

exercises.name: Seiza & Optional Camel Pose
cues: Kneel, then slowly sit the hips back to the heels as low as comfortable; pause, then rise.
Toes pointed (ankle plantarflexion) or tucked (sole of the foot); pillows between legs and hips to shorten the range.
Optional camel: from hips forward reach one or both hands to the heels, open the chest and push the hips forward.

exercises.name: Lounge Chair & Crab Press
cues: Seated, knees bent, hands behind the hips with fingers pointing away.
Lounge chair: lift the hips, move them forward and set them down to stretch the front of the shoulders.
Crab press: from the same start press the hips straight up like a glute bridge. Breathe out as the arms go behind.

exercises.name: Straight Leg Hinge
cues: Stand feet shoulder width, strong arch in the lower back (hand there for feedback).
Keep the arch, let the chest fall forward as the hips drive back; only as far as the back stays extended.
Squeeze the glutes to come back up. Progression: staggered single-leg stance.

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper & Back Fold
cues: Lie on the back, arms out in a T, knees lifted above the hips.
Keep back and shoulders down, let the legs fall to one side; pause 3-5 s, back to center, other side.
Aim to get the knees to the floor with the opposite shoulder down; breathe in on the transition, out as the knees go down.

exercises.name: Squat Pikes
cues: Start in a shallow squat with hands on the knees.
Push the knees back to straighten them while pulling the torso into a forward fold, then back to the squat; go deeper with each rep.
Use a wedge under the heels if needed. Breathe in on the squat, out on the pike.

exercises.name: Crawl
cues: Hands and knees: wrists under shoulders, knees under hips; lift the knees slightly by digging the toes in.
Move the opposite hand and foot forward together, alternate sides; then crawl backward the same number of steps.
Variations: stiff-spine crawl (brace the core) and spine-movement crawl (let hips and shoulders rotate).

exercises.name: Horse Stance Rotation
cues: Stance wider than shoulders, feet mostly forward, hips as low as you could hold for 1 minute.
Reach one arm in front and one behind, eyes following the back hand; push the fingertips away from each other.
Alternate sides, keeping the hips in the same position.

sessions.name: Daily Practice
sessions.notes: Become more flexible and less stiff in about 15 minutes. Ten movements, one round each, in this order.

exercises.note: 5-10 reps (in and out) on each leg separately + 5 reps moving both legs together (start, other side, back to start = 1 rep)
8-10 reps + 10-20 s hold on the last rep (in the stretched position)
30-60 s on each side (choose the variation or combination for your current level)
5-10 reps + 10-20 s hold on the last rep (plus camel pose if it suits you)
5-10 reps + 10-20 s hold on the last rep (in the stretched position)
8-10 reps + 10-20 s hold on the last rep (in the stretched position)
3-5 reps each side (hold the stretched position 3-5 s each rep; optional longer hold on the last rep)
5-10 reps + 10-20 s hold on the last rep (in both squat and pike position)
10 steps forward + small break + 10 steps forward (turn around and crawl back). More challenge: 10 steps forward + 10 steps backward
